'''Hras'kkk'rarr''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Srrors'tok]],<ref name="GG9" /> a [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jankok]]<ref name="AlienEncounters" /> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for the [[Jankok system/Legends|Jankok system]]</ref> It was a very sophisticated combination of<ref name="GG9" /> [[Sign language/Legends|sign language]] and a complex series of growls, snarls, clicks,<ref name="AlienEncounters" /> and other sounds that were easy for the [[Larynx/Legends|voice boxes]] of the Srrors'tok to produce&mdash;although that same anatomical structure also made it very difficult for them to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].<ref name="GG9" /> The Srrors'tok [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tyionsis Cex]], who was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], had developed an ability to throw his voice, projecting apparent growling noises indicative of the presence of other Srrors'tok in his vicinity.<ref name="GG10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hras'kkk'rarr was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', which was written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="GG9" />
